summary: Langfuse is an open-source platform designed for engineering large language model applications. It provides tooling to trace model executions, manage prompts, and evaluate the performance of systems like chatbots and AI agents.
goodFor: Development teams building production-grade language model applications who need collaborative debugging and monitoring infrastructure.
watchOut: Self-hosting this platform adds an operational burden, as you must maintain its underlying data stores and handle data privacy concerns for sensitive prompt logs.
deployNotes: Deployment relies on Docker, so you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
